// divguard:path internal/codingagent/interactive_turn.go

package codingagent

import "context"

type Agent struct{}

func (*Agent) SendContent(context.Context, string) error { return nil }
func (*Agent) Continue(context.Context) error            { return nil }

type InteractiveMode struct {
	agent    *Agent
	abortCtx context.Context
}

// runTurn reproduces MODES-01 and MODES-08: the mode drives the agent
// itself, so nothing drains the follow-up queue after the run, and retries
// fork the session's recovery loop.
func (m *InteractiveMode) runTurn(text string) error {
	if err := m.agent.SendContent(m.abortCtx, text); err != nil { // want
		return m.agent.Continue(m.abortCtx) // want
	}
	return nil
}
